title: Lavender Cheesecake Swirl: A Vegan Ice Cream Tutorial with a Dear Bella Creamery Inspiration

locations.name: Dear Bella Creamery, Los Angeles, CA (probable)
locations.basis: Transcript notes visit to Dear Bella Creamery and LA context ('best vegan ice cream in LA')

summary: This Goodful video follows hosts Merle and Lindsay as they first visit Dear Bella Creamery in Los Angeles to sample vegan flavors, then return to the studio to build a scratch-made lavender-infused vegan ice cream with cheesecake chunks. The process blends practical dairy-free techniques (oat-milk base, coconut oil fat, and cocoa butter for creaminess) with a vegan cheesecake layer (soaked cashews, coconut milk, vanilla, lemon, miso, and vegan cream cheese). The lavender flavor is infused, blueberry jam adds color and aroma, and natural spirulina colors a blue swirl. The base and cheesecake components are prepared separately, chilled/frozen in stages, then layered together and churned before a final six-hour freeze. The result is a fully vegan dessert that aims to match traditional textures and flavors while highlighting scratch-made ingredients and careful texture control, with a post-taste rating session comparing the homemade batch to the shop flavors.

sections.title: Intro and LA vegan ice cream shop visit
sections.description: Merle introduces Lindsay, outlines the plan to visit a top LA vegan ice cream shop, and frames the episode around comparing shop flavors to a homemade vegan batch.

sections.title: Cheesecake crust and base prep
concepts: graham cracker crust with coconut oil
sections.description: The hosts prepare a graham-cracker crust, then assemble a cheesecake base using soaked cashews, coconut milk, vanilla, lemon juice, miso, and vegan cream cheese, ready to set in the crust and freeze.

sections.title: Lavender base infusion, jam, and color options
sections.description: Lavender is steeped into a fruity base with blueberry jam for flavor and color. They discuss color options (natural coloring vs. optional coloring) and incorporate cocoa butter to improve texture.

sections.title: Churning, layering, and final freezing
sections.description: The lavender base is blended and churned, then the cheesecake pieces are layered into the churned ice cream. The mixture is frozen in stages—4 hours for the cheesecake layer and a final 6-hour freeze for scoopable texture.

sections.title: Tasting, rating, and wrap-up
concepts: wrap-up and call for audience suggestions
sections.description: Merle and Lindsay taste the finished lavender-cheesecake vegan ice cream, rate it, and discuss how it stacks up against Dear Bella’s flavors before closing with audience requests for future guests and flavors.
